reviews.review_msg: It was clear that Professor Van den Brink has a comprehensive knowledge of the material and he made the seminars very interesting and engaging. The grading was fair and he gave helpful feedback. I felt I had a well rounded understanding of the course material by the end of the semester and would highly recommend this course to other students.

I took POL 428 Selected Topic: Canadian Right-wing Politics and I really enjoyed the way the class was ran. It was a seminar so if you read the content and make an effort to engage, he is really fair with marking. Discussions were interesting and open to all perspectives as long as they were argumentatively sound based on the readings/literature.
He knows his stuff and cares, but its hard to get an A
